title: Came with dirty spots and damage
text: Came with dirty spots and damage. This rug came dirty and damaged and the stitching is all over the place and is red.  The rug is white, which is nice and the colors are pretty but the red stitching which is wonky is off-putting and the dirty spots and damaged worn marks were disappointing.

product_metadata.title: NuLOOM Tammara Bohemian Hand Braided Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 6', Multi
features: Refreshingly lightweight cotton rugs are perfect for dining room, living room, kitchen, entryway, bedrooms, and best when sheltered from direct sunlight
Sleek and functional 0.35" thickness allows for convenient placement in entryways and underneath furniture
Handmade rugs should be treated more carefully than machine-made rugs. We recommend shaking out dirt or debris and spot treating mild stains
We recommend pairing with a nuLOOM non-slip rug pad for added thickness and floor protection
description: Brighten your room with this distinctively vivid bohemian area rug. Hand braided in India of recycled cotton, each piece carries with it a variation in color and pattern unique to the artisan who made it. This floor covering is the perfect addition to any space in your home that needs a pop of color. Create the home you have always dreamed of with our pet-friendly and easy to care for area rugs.
